_about: Public-domain Howell Harris (1714-1773), Welsh Calvinistic Methodist evangelist of Trevecca, for the Word Hoard: A Letter from Mr. Howel Harris to a congregation in London (1743), The Last Message and Dying Testimony of Howell Harris (1774) and A Brief Account of the Life of Howell Harris, extracted from his papers (1791), from Internet Archive scans of Eighteenth Century Collections. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 50 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hharris-letter-1743: A letter from Mr. Howel Harris in Wales, to a congregation in London, concerning brotherly love and mutual forbearance amongst true Christians. With an explanatory introduction by a welwisher to peace and truth.  1743 (catalogued 1743)
hharris-last-message: The last message, and dying testimony, of Howell Harris, Esqr; late of Trevecka in Wales. ...  1774 (catalogued 1774)
hharris-brief-account: A brief account of the life of Howell Harris, Esq; extracted from papers written by himself. To which is added a concise collection of his letters from the year 1738, to 1772.  1791 (catalogued 1791)
